pnpm.//: dockerode drags in ssh2 (for docker-over-ssh, which we never use) and ssh2 drags in cpu-features; both have node-gyp install scripts and both are optional accelerators with pure-JS fallbacks. Building them would put node-gyp back into `pnpm install` — exactly the step `docs/decisions/0001-bun-runtime-keep-vite.md` removed by choosing bun:sqlite over better-sqlite3. We talk to the daemon over its unix socket, so nothing here is even loaded.
